newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-AJAX TURN DOWN YUGOSLAV STRIKER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AJAX TURN DOWN YUGOSLAV STRIKER.

text.p: Ajax Amsterdam have decided not to sign Yuglosav Rade Bogdanovic, after giving the player a trial during their training camp in Spain.
The club said the 26-year-old striker did not fit the Ajax system and he is now expected to join J. League club JEF United instead.

The winter-break has given Ajax the chance to get most of their injured players fit for the second half of the season which re-starts in mid-February and which will see them attempt to haul back their 18-point deficit on league leaders PSV Eindhoven.

Ajax have made one new signing -- Groningen midfielder Dean Gorre, who was his side's top scorer in the first half of the season with eight goals. He will link up with Ajax at the start of next season.

Ajax made no comment on Friday on renewed speculation linking Patrick Kluivert with Arsenal. The rumours, which have been around for months, would appear to contradict earlier reports that he has signed a pre-contract to join AC Milan next season.
Feyenoord meanwhile, currently second in the table, have offered midfielder Jean-Paul van Gastel a new contract until mid-2000.
